Title: Agent Bounds (Locked)
Content: Agent bounds are locked per spec: MaxIterations=4, MaxTokensPerLoop=12000 (budget ceiling; model context window is 8K so prompt+history+output must fit both limits), DefaultTimeout=300s. The agent is a deterministic state machine implemented in Orchestrator.Agents with strict iteration, token, and safety limits. These values do NOT change without explicit architectural review.
